title: Buzz cleaned post-call record (n8n -> HubSpot / Google Sheets)
description: Built by the n8n post-call flow from the Dograh webhook body. Typed (no stringified values), transcript and summary redacted by POST /v1/redact, opt-out confirmed against the suppression service. Nothing else from the call leaves the app server. No recording URLs.

delivery_id.description: X-Dograh-Delivery-Id header; idempotency key in HubSpot/Sheets

contact_e164.description: The other party: called_number for outbound, caller_number for inbound, normalised by GET /v1/check. null if it did not normalise

disposition.description: mapped_call_disposition if set, else call_disposition, else call_status. Dograh rule for user codes: letter, then letters/digits/_/-, max 64

transcript.description: Redacted. null when Sheets-only or when the transcript was unavailable

opt_out.description: true if the contact is on the suppression list after this call (GET /v1/check reason=suppressed)

consent.description: The HubSpot consent property to write. The property name is a placeholder until agreed with the HubSpot admin (verify)

value.description: withdrawn when opt_out is true; otherwise unchanged (the call never grants consent)
